workTitle: A Song of Ice and Fire — Winterfell opening route (calibration)

styleAnchor.palette: desaturated northern cold: slate, charcoal, muted brown, sparse warm ember accents indoors
styleAnchor.texture: painterly cinematic illustration, soft film grain, no photoreal face close-up
styleAnchor.camera_language: medium-wide / wide storybook stills; profiles and lowered gazes; faces secondary to props and place
styleAnchor.lighting: moody directional light; deep shadow on faces acceptable; avoid bright frontal key on faces

frames.label: Route I — Godswood after execution
frames.title: Ned and Catelyn in the Godswood
frames.caption: Catelyn finds Ned sitting quietly by the dark waters of the heart tree, cleaning his Valyrian steel sword Ice after an execution.

identitySupport.relationshipCue: wife approaches husband in sacred grove

policy.composition_focus: greatsword and heart-tree pool; figures secondary
policy.lighting_style: cool mist, faces in soft shadow

expression.environment: godswood dark pool and large tree

characters.visual: bearded man in fur cloak seated cleaning greatsword head bowed
woman in dark gown standing in profile

expression.action: lady standing near seated lord with long sword by dark pool
expression.composition: wide shot tree and pool, two figures, faces secondary

frames.beforeNotes: Web Route 1: Ned face muddy/collapsed in shadow; Catelyn face small and soft; event readable via sword+grove but uncanny risk high on Ned.

frames.label: Route II — Grave news delivered
frames.title: News of Jon Arryn's Death and the Royal Visit
frames.caption: Catelyn delivers grave news of Jon Arryn's death and King Robert's journey north to Winterfell.

identitySupport.relationshipCue: wife brings grave letter to husband indoors

policy.composition_focus: shared parchment on table; profiles only
policy.lighting_style: warm indoor ember key; faces in profile shadow

expression.environment: dim winterfell solar wooden table candlelight

characters.visual: auburn-haired woman in dark gown holding parchment in profile
bearded man in fur-trimmed cloak seated profile looking down at letter

frames.label: Route III — Betrothal and Lysa's letter
frames.title: Betrothal and the Suspicion of Murder
frames.caption: King Robert proposes a marriage between Prince Joffrey and Sansa, while Lysa's letter accuses the Lannisters of murder.

identitySupport.relationshipCue: political talk over dual documents (betrothal + accusation)

policy.lighting_style: warm low key; lowered gazes on parchment

characters.visual: bearded king in dark royal cloak looking down at parchment profile
